## Checklist

- [ ] `docs/design.md` is updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Tests added or updated, with IDs from `docs/test-plan.md` in the test names
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes (for page changes)
- [ ] Strings are in all five languages (en, zh, es, fr, de)
- [ ] No personal data (names, emails, hostnames, family details) in code, docs, tests or commit messages
